::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A Wikipedia-dump survivor check: the 'Hanking Electronics, Fushun' row is real but obscure — 罕王微电子 is not the same company as Suzhou Hanking (a fabless SAW designer, whose separate Changshu line 臻芯微 went live 2022-10). Listed on MIIT's official IC-producer roster and a 2017 'Made in China 2025' showcase line.
:::

**Chinese name:** 罕王微电子（辽宁）有限公司 (Hǎnwáng Wēidiànzǐ (Liáoníng))

## What does this facility make?

MEMS sensors (pressure, inertial, gas) on 200mm, IDM + MUMPs-style foundry services.

## Why does it matter?

Included with an explicit low-confidence flag: the site is live and the company still exists, but there is no independent 2025-26 news flow confirming utilization or viability — a candidate for the 'operational-but-quiet' grey zone that this tracker marks as not verified rather than dropping.
